itinerary.title: Welcome to your Srinagar base
itinerary.description: Transfer to the agreed stay and allow time to settle in. Discuss the purpose of your visit, walking comfort, dietary preferences and any observance you hope to attend. The coordinator checks visiting arrangements before the sightseeing days; a late arrival is kept free of compulsory stops.
experiences: Arrival transfer at the agreed time
A planning conversation about interests and appropriate visiting etiquette
itinerary.routeNote: Current custodian permission, worship arrangements, weather and individual walking suitability decide access and the final sequence. No ceremony or religious interior is guaranteed.

itinerary.title: Two churches, time for each community
itinerary.place: Holy Family Catholic Church · All Saints Church
itinerary.description: Request visits to Holy Family Catholic Church on Maulana Azad Road and All Saints Church in Srinagar. These are separate Christian communities and their own worship and visitor arrangements apply. Ask each church before planning attendance at a service or photographing an interior. If one is closed to visitors, choose an exterior view or a shared-heritage alternative rather than assuming entry.
experiences: A respectful introduction to the churches and their setting
Service attendance only when invited or permitted by the church
itinerary.routeNote: Current custodian permission, worship arrangements, weather and individual walking suitability decide access and the final sequence. No ceremony or religious interior is guaranteed.
itinerary.meals: Breakfast and dinner proposed; other food separately agreed

itinerary.title: Bait-ul-Meeras and everyday Kashmir
itinerary.place: Bait-ul-Meeras, Aali Kadal · appointed craft visit
itinerary.description: Visit Bait-ul-Meeras, the heritage house and cultural centre run by HELP Foundation, subject to its current opening and visitor arrangements. Ask what gallery spaces are available and whether a craft demonstration can be arranged. The visit offers cultural context alongside the church programme; access to manuscripts, private rooms or a workshop is not automatically included.
places: One appointed craft visit if confirmed
experiences: A gallery visit focused on everyday objects and local making
Time for questions and optional nearby lane exploration

itinerary.title: Leave time for the onward journey
itinerary.description: Have breakfast if departure timing permits, then take the agreed transfer. Airport and road buffers come before any extra visit. Additional shrines or outlying sites need a revised itinerary rather than a last-minute detour.
